code.note: Shell archive, not a plain source file: gunzip, then read it; do not execute it. It contains Fortran77/Drivers/Dp/driver.f (PROGRAM SCTEST), port.f, the reference outputs res1..res4 and Fortran77/Src/Dp/src.f (AIZ and the Airy routines) and src_819.f (GIZ, HIZ and their series, integral and expansion helpers). The Makefile lists driver.o src.o airy.f port.f, which does not match the file names in the archive (src_819.f holds GIZ/HIZ), so the rerun must work out the build from the sources. port.f is a machine-constant file that needs editing for a modern compiler.

field: numerics (special functions: complex Scorer functions HI(z) and GI(z), tested via their addition formulas)

claim.location: The shipped reference output res1 (the file the driver SCTEST writes as 'Res1', header 'TEST OF THE UNSCALED GI(Z)'), last block line in the file: 'MAXIMUM VALUE OF THE MODULUS OF THE CHECK = 9.1704421834038D-14' at line 15666 of the uncompressed 822 shell archive (the file res1 begins at line 706). The driver computes it by evaluating GI(Z+W) against its Taylor series over the grid R=0.1..29.7 (step 0.6, 50 values) and PHI=pi*J/1800 for J=10..1800 step 6, with W=0.1 (archive text lines 133-204, the driver's main loop).

reference.sha256: not computed; the value is quoted here and compared as a number

claim.metric: The maximum modulus of the addition-formula residual for the unscaled GI(Z) (IFAC=1, driver's GITEST modulus error) over the driver's grid, as printed by the rerun driver into its res1 file. Claim: the rerun's value is at most 1e-12 in absolute terms.
claim.paper_value: Shipped reference value 9.1704421834038D-14 (printed by the authors' driver in res1; the article text, which might state a relative accuracy bound, was not read; the 2003 archive file is the only numeric value checked here).

tolerance.basis: Round-off-level quantity: the shipped value is 9.2e-14 and the residual is a difference of sums of order 1, so a modern compiler may move it by a small factor. 1e-12 allows roughly one decade of slack above the shipped value and still rejects a formula or series error, which shows up at 1e-6 or larger. Fixed now, before any run; not to be loosened after a run.

cost.cpu_minutes_estimate: Under 1 minute for the driver (grid of 50 x 300 points, a few function evaluations each).
cost.data_size: None: the grid is generated in the driver.
cost.data_licence: No data. Source is the public netlib TOMS collected-algorithms archive.

why: The driver computes its residual from GI(Z) at run time, so the printed maximum has to come from running the routine; the shipped res1 is a machine-independent-enough round-off check that tests bit-rot in GIZ on a modern compiler, which is the artifact-match level of the rubric.
